beats.text: Every cylinder in your engine fires twenty-five times a second.
Intake. The piston drops, and sucks in air and fuel.
Compression. The valves shut, and the mix is squeezed tight.
Power. A spark ignites it, and the blast drives the piston down.
Exhaust. The piston rises, and pushes the burnt gas out.
Four strokes. Two turns. That's your engine.
